name: dev.meshprotect
description: Mesh protection for VRChat avatars. Add one component, press Build & Publish. lilToon natively; Poiyomi Toon, XSToon, UTS, Sunao, GTAvaToon and blackbody by automatic grafts; lilSSAO and lilSSRT by a merged shader family. Every avatar gets its own generated cipher and shader, so breaking one teaches an attacker nothing about the next.
